title: Epstein Theory Lab
boundary: The Theory Lab is for hypothesis mapping only. It is not evidence, not accusation, not proof of wrongdoing, and not a substitute for court records or verified sources. The system keeps theories separate from the evidence ledger.
rules: Every theory must be labelled speculation unless supported by evidence levels 4 to 5.
No person may be labelled as having done anything serious without court-confirmed evidence.
Theory cards must include what would support and what would falsify the theory.
Theory cards cannot update dossiers as fact unless manually promoted after source review.

hypotheses.title: Missing-record pressure point
hypotheses.hypothesis: If a source route has many mentions but no original exhibit or surrounding pages, the correct action is to prioritise missing records rather than strengthen the claim.
hypotheses.whyItInterestsReaders: It gives researchers a clear next step without overstating the evidence.
whatWouldFalsifyIt: complete source record showing no relevant context
hypotheses.whatThisDoesNotProve: It proves no wrongdoing and names no person.
